title: Auth Methods Overview
summary: trust is only for disposable local labs, peer maps an operating-system user, md5 is legacy password verification, scram-sha-256 is the preferred password method, and cert-based authentication moves trust to a client certificate chain. SCRAM over md5 matters because the verifier and exchange resist offline password attacks better.
learning_objectives: Explain the operational purpose of Auth Methods Overview.
Collect PostgreSQL evidence before proposing remediation.
Describe verification and rollback for the administrative action.
reflection_prompts: What evidence would you attach to an incident review?
Which part of the remediation has the largest operational blast radius?
